source: Pew Research Center. 2014. "Religion in Latin America: Widespread Change in a Historically Catholic Region."
method: Population is respondent's own current religion (QCURRELrec), pooled across all 18 Latin American/Caribbean countries and Puerto Rico. Weekly+ combines "more than once a week" and "once a week" on Q45; don't know/refused excluded from each row's denominator. Weighted by the dataset's own combined base/post-stratification WEIGHT.
